scope: Four stationary response-basis arms and completed basis002 paired finite-query intervention, preserved basis001 replay, compact reduction and proposed short fitted-query next step. Attribution proof has its separate review.

findings.finding: Both H directions remain joint. Mapping u=(k/k_center-cosh(1))/sinh(1) maps exactly the existing positive log-halfwidth-one support to [-1,1]. Node rates use its inverse; basis_query applies du/dlog(k)=k/(k_center*sinh(1)). RC stays degree2 in log-tau. The representation changes no prior or base measure.
findings.disposition: Accepted for stationary 25C observations and current admitted physical paths. No support enlargement or migration is demonstrated.

findings.finding: One QR factor compresses all response columns, constant offset and cross terms. For fixed shapes residual is affine in amplitudes, so conditional amplitude precision is J_a^T J_a and PSD in exact arithmetic. Full nonlinear observed Hessian need not be PSD.
findings.disposition: Accepted structural remedy for prior entrywise-curvature failure, not an approximation or posterior-coverage certificate.

findings.finding: BasisField features/residual/nll/outgoing agree with the selected coordinate; basis002 preserves all 1872 original query-arm records exactly. Legacy external features_jacobian/transported/Compressed assume log-coordinate features and must not be treated as compatible with rate-coordinate arms.
findings.disposition: Current runner correctly uses evaluate. The bound experiment README warns to use basis_query plus explicit chart chain. New fitted implementation requires its own derivative/transport checks and review.

findings.finding: Widths34/42 give packed factors4760/7224B; state312/424B; stated lower subtotals5168/7744B and retained NumPy arrays10400/16240B are consistent. Update scratch alone includes278528/344064B response rows and287776/358176B stacked QR inputs, plus input, transactional state/root and library scratch. Listed categories are not a complete concurrent peak.
findings.disposition: 2576B extra retained numeric payload is a tradeoff, not complete10KiB feasibility. Host timings exclude queries/solver/system and are single runs, not M23 benchmarks.

findings.finding: Log-degree3 improves191/306 active probes and worsens115, including91/153 embedded probes. Its embedded all-prefix maximum is0.0420324 versus baseline0.0631214; one-hour maximum0.0267332 is not the all-prefix maximum. Rate-degree2 worsens153/153 embedded probes; rate-degree3 worsens142/153.
findings.disposition: Report faithfully preserves regressions and distinguishes maxima. Neither coordinate change nor added degree is a monotonic or robust per-query repair. Different degree includes different projection grid.

findings.finding: Short common-prefix fitted-query comparison of direct history, H7, log-degree2 and log-degree3 can assess application return on added memory. Existing unfitted relative gradient probes cannot establish SOC/Q shifts, uncertainty validity or forecast safety.
findings.disposition: Accept as next experiment, not an implemented result. Preserve original prior once, common source/chronology and supported domains; report failures and solver status separately from physical accuracy. Use SOC0.5pp/Q1% development goals without converting them into coverage or safety authorization.

limits: Finite adaptive exploratory probes through one hour, not independent confirmation or uniform response/derivative bounds.
Conditional sum-of-squares structure does not establish calibrated uncertainty, useful fitted estimates or all nonlinear Hessian properties.
No campaign adapter/fitted solver, aging, ten-year history, support migration, unattended recovery, target WCET or complete SRAM qualification.
No production/default/mainline or target-kernel promotion is accepted.
acceptance: Accept current source-bound basis intervention, negative/mixed outcome interpretation and narrow next-step recommendation conditionally; no remaining blocker for this diagnostic scope.
